scope: Proposition 3.3 (Integral lift and conjugates) of the manuscript “An integral counterexample to Gersten's conjecture” (preprints/An-Integral-Counterexample-to-Gerstens-Conjecture-September-25-2026/An-Integral-Counterexample-to-Gerstens-Conjecture-September-25-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 209 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 c2fa194c832cce8c), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 11. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let u = ζ − 1 ∈ S×, and let b be multiplication by the class β in (3.1). There exists c ∈ K5(S) such that c mod 5 = b2 [u]5 in K5(S; 5). (3.4) For every δ ∈ ∆, (δc) mod 5 = χ(δ)2 b2 [δu]5 in K5(S; 5). (3.5) For any fixed homomorphism ι : S → H to a field, let resι denote extension of scalars. Restriction of these equalities gives the corresponding identities in K5(H; 5). In the second identity this means resι(δc) mod 5 = χ(δ)2 b2 ι [ι(δu)]5, where bι is multiplication by resι(β); no action of δ on H is required.
